system.description: Use this Skill when there are consequences for not swimming strongly or well. If you're racing for your life, swimming against a strong current, or trying to get to shore to avoid a waterfall, make an Unopposed Skill Check every 30 seconds. On Success, you swim well despite the danger.

upgrades.description: After 2 minutes of Swimming (Success or Fail), gain the Fatigued Debuff.
You can swim at your full Move rate as an Action, but you still can't take a 10ft Step.
Make this Check every 5 minutes, and only gain the Fatigue Debuff on a Critical Fail.

system.limitations: After 1 minute of Swimming (Success or Fail) or immediately on a Major Fail or worse, gain the Fatigued Debuff.
